reviews.title: Great power supply, extremely quiet!
reviews.comment:
I chose this power supply to run my GPU in my Plex media server, which runs 24-7 and gets a lot of use.  I had a power supply in there that was seven years old and I was concerned it would die soon.  The new power supply is 700 watts, replacing my old one at 650 watts.  When I first started installing it I didn't think any of the cables would work, but realized that I just needed to split one of them apart, which is pretty typical for these units.  The power supply fit inside the computer perfectly.  The computer booted right up with the new power supply and it's been running smoothly without issue.
I have this computer in an area where I sit and work for extended periods of time, so one of the things that really sold me on this power supply was that it said it had a "silent fan."  Well sure enough, it's so quiet it can barely be heard!  It made me realize how loud and annoying the last one was, and I'm thankful to have a quiet place to work.
I think this power supply is a good value for the money and seems like a quality item.  Very happy with it.
reviews.author: Byrnes983
